dialogues.speaker: Iradj
dialogues.text: Tell me, where can I find a claymore that's both elegant and easy to use?

dialogues.speaker: Iradj
dialogues.text: Ahaha... I'm not that skilled. I only dabble with scimitars.

dialogues.speaker: Iradj
dialogues.text: Anyway, it's not for me. I was hoping to find a handy weapon for Flame-Mane, a fellow Eremite.

dialogues.speaker: Iradj
dialogues.text: She wields greatswords the best among us. Seeing her in action is always a glorious sight to behold...

dialogues.speaker: Iradj
dialogues.text: If I can find the best greatsword in all of Sumeru, then I must get it for her! I only hope she won't refuse it when I do...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't you go ask the blacksmith?

dialogues.speaker: Iradj
dialogues.text: The blacksmith, huh... I'd better not.

dialogues.speaker: Iradj
dialogues.text: The boss there is my adoptive father. He's always talking about wanting us to come back and take over the family business.

dialogues.speaker: Iradj
dialogues.text: He's been a great father to us, so we always feel bad whenever we have to turn him down...

dialogues.speaker: Iradj
dialogues.text: So, it's best that I don't bother him with this sword matter.

dialogues.speaker: Iradj
dialogues.text: You don't know either, huh...? It's fine.
